thread:
Maya Chen: Thinking about a compact 'episodic' welcome mini-series for new signups — 3 short emails over 10 days, each a small story/feature highlight + tiny CTA. Goal: move to first product milestone (trial start or demo). Thoughts?
Samir Patel: Love the idea. keeps friction low and builds habit. Recommend cohorting by signup intent (signup source + plan).
Jon Park: +1. For timing I’d do Day 0 (welcome + setup), Day 3 (value story + how-to), Day 9 (social proof + invite). 10-day span sounds right.
Leila Gomez: Copy notes — keep voice breezy, 1-2 short bullets, 1 primary link. Example subject lines: "Start small: 3 quick wins with Redwood", "Your first inference in 5 mins".
Ava Li: Metrics to track: 1) Day-3 open rate, 2) Day-9 CTA click-to-demo, 3) conversion to trial. Also capture cohort by acquisition channel.
Maya Chen: Segmentation — propose 3 cohorts: "Explorer" (docs/OSS), "Product" (trial signups), "Enterprise" (signup via sales). Different CTA per cohort.
Samir Patel: Agree. Also flag high-cost enterprise leads for immediate SE handoff in the welcome email ("Talk to sales" CTA).
Leila Gomez: Draft micro-copy for Day 0 (Explorer): "Welcome — here's a tiny demo repo & 2 commands to try." Day 3: short tip + example. Day 9: testimonial + invite to a 20-min webinar.
Jon Park: Webinar as follow-up is good. Schedule it as on-demand recording link in email + a live monthly session CTA for high-intent users.
Maya Chen: Can we A/B test: Variant A = single CTA (start trial), Variant B = split CTA (start trial + watch 5-min demo)? Run on Product cohort only for first batch.
Ava Li: Set up tracking keys: utm_campaign=episodic_welcome, utm_content=variantA|B. Also instrument custom event `welcome_episode_engaged` with episode number.
Samir Patel: Ops checklist (quick):
```
- Build HTML templates for 3 episodes
- Segment lists by source/intent
- Wire tracking & UTM
- QA send on staging domain
- Set automated handoff for enterprise leads
```
Leila Gomez: I'll drop drafts by EOD tomorrow. Can someone push the template into the send tool?
Jon Park: I can do the template push + QA on Friday morning.
Maya Chen: Great — next steps: Leila copy, Samir to set segments & handoff, Jon to deploy templates, Ava to configure analytics. @launch-bot schedule a dry-run on staging Friday 09:00 PT. :rocket:
launch-bot: Scheduled dry-run for 2024-04-19 09:00 PT on staging. Reminder set 30m prior.
Ava Li: Quick note — keep email size <120KB, avoid heavy images for mobile.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after dry-run for results and finalize live rollout window. :thumbsup:
